verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי אֶת־ אֲדֹנָ֜י נִצָּ֣ב עַֽל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ הַ֨ךְ הַכַּפְתּ֜וֹר וְיִרְעֲשׁ֣וּ הַסִּפִּ֗ים וּבְצַ֙עַם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖ם בַּחֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא־ יָנ֤וּס לָהֶם֙ נָ֔ס וְלֹֽא־ יִמָּלֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם פָּלִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: rā·’î·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·nāy niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ way·yō·mer haḵ hak·kap̄·tō·wr wə·yir·‘ă·šū has·sip·pîm ū·ḇə·ṣa·‘am bə·rōš kul·lām wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯām ba·ḥe·reḇ ’e·hĕ·rōḡ lō- yā·nūs lā·hem nās wə·lō- yim·mā·lêṭ lā·hem pā·lîṭ
verses.literal: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar and He said Strike the tops of the pillars so that the thresholds shake Topple them on the heads of all the people and I will kill the rest with the sword None of those who flee will get away none of the fugitives will escape
verses.literalPt: VI o Senhor, que estava em pé sobre o altar; e me disse: Fere o capitel, e estremeçam os umbrais, e faze tudo em pedaços sobre a cabeça de todos eles; e eu matarei à espada até ao último deles; nenhum deles conseguirá fugir, nenhum deles escapará.

verses.original: אִם־ יַחְתְּר֣וּ בִשְׁא֔וֹל מִשָּׁ֖ם יָדִ֣י תִקָּחֵ֑ם וְאִֽם־ יַעֲלוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִשָּׁ֖ם אוֹרִידֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yaḥ·tə·rū ḇiš·’ō·wl miš·šām yā·ḏî ṯiq·qā·ḥêm wə·’im- ya·‘ă·lū haš·šā·ma·yim miš·šām ’ō·w·rî·ḏêm
verses.literal: Though they dig down to Sheol from there My hand will take them and though they climb up to heaven from there I will pull them down
verses.literalPt: Ainda que cavem até ao inferno, a minha mão os tirará dali; e, se subirem ao céu, dali os farei descer.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל מִשָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּלְקַחְתִּ֑ים וְאִם־ יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִנֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַי֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַיָּ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־ הַנָּחָ֖שׁ וּנְשָׁכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yê·ḥā·ḇə·’ū bə·rōš hak·kar·mel miš·šām ’ă·ḥap·pêś ū·lə·qaḥ·tîm wə·’im- yis·sā·ṯə·rū min·ne·ḡeḏ ‘ê·nay bə·qar·qa‘ hay·yām miš·šām ’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- han·nā·ḥāš ū·nə·šā·ḵām
verses.literal: Though they hide themselves atop Carmel there I will track them and seize them and though they hide from Me at the bottom of the sea there I will command the serpent to bite them
verses.literalPt: E, se se esconderem no cume do Carmelo, buscá-los-ei, e dali os tirarei; e, se dos meus olhos se ocultarem no fundo do mar, ali darei ordem à serpente, e ela os picará.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יֵלְכ֤וּ בַשְּׁבִי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיבֵיהֶ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־ הַחֶ֖רֶב וַהֲרָגָ֑תַם וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָעָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yê·lə·ḵū ḇaš·šə·ḇî lip̄·nê ʾ·ḇē·hɛm miš·šām ’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ wa·hă·rā·ḡā·ṯam wə·śam·tî ‘ê·nî ‘ă·lê·hem lə·rā·‘āh wə·lō lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh
verses.literal: Though they are driven by their enemies into captivity there I will command the sword to slay them I will fix My eyes upon them for harm and not for good
verses.literalPt: E, se forem em cativeiro diante de seus inimigos, ali darei ordem à espada que os mate; e eu porei os meus olhos sobre eles para o mal, e não para o bem.

verses.original: וַאדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה הַצְּבָא֗וֹת הַנּוֹגֵ֤עַ בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ וַתָּמ֔וֹג וְאָבְל֖וּ כָּל־ י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כַיְאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְשָׁקְעָ֖ה כִּיאֹ֥ר מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.transliteration: wa·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ han·nō·w·ḡê·a‘ bā·’ā·reṣ wat·tā·mō·wḡ wə·’ā·ḇə·lū kāl- yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḇāh wə·‘ā·lə·ṯāh ḵay·’ōr kul·lāh wə·šā·qə·‘āh kî·’ōr miṣ·rå̄·yim
verses.literal: The Lord GOD of Hosts He who touches the earth and it melts and all its dwellers mourn all the land rises like the Nile then sinks like the river of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Porque o Senhor DEUS dos Exércitos é o que toca a terra, e ela se derrete, e todos os que habitam nela chorarão; e ela subirá toda como um rio, e abaixará como o rio do Egito.

verses.original: הַבּוֹנֶ֤ה בַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מַעֲלוֹתוֹ וַאֲגֻדָּת֖וֹ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ יְסָדָ֑הּ הַקֹּרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־ הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bō·w·neh ḇaš·šā·ma·yim ma·ʿă·lō·ṯō wa·’ă·ḡud·dā·ṯōw ‘al- ’e·reṣ yə·sā·ḏāh haq·qō·rê lə·mê- hay·yām way·yiš·pə·ḵêm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ā·reṣ Yah·weh šə·mōw
verses.literal: He builds His upper rooms in the heavens and founds His vault upon the earth He summons the waters of the sea and pours them over the face of the earth The LORD is His name
verses.literalPt: Ele é o que edifica as suas câmaras superiores no céu, e fundou na terra a sua abóbada, e o que chama as águas do mar, e as derrama sobre a terra; o SENHOR é o seu nome.

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא כִבְנֵי֩ כֻשִׁיִּ֨ים אַתֶּ֥ם לִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּפְלִשְׁתִּיִּ֥ים מִכַּפְתּ֖וֹר וַאֲרָ֥ם מִקִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w ḵiḇ·nê ḵu·šî·yîm ’at·tem lî bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh hă·lō·w ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl he·‘ĕ·lê·ṯî mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·p̄ə·liš·tî·yîm mik·kap̄·tō·wr wa·’ă·rām miq·qîr
verses.literal: Are you not . . . like the Cushites to Me O children of Israel declares the LORD Did I not bring Israel up from the land of Egypt the Philistines from Caphtor and the Arameans from Kir
verses.literalPt: Não me sois, vós, ó filhos de Israel, como os filhos dos etíopes? diz o SENHOR: Não fiz eu subir a Israel da terra do Egito, e aos filisteus de Caftor, e aos sírios de Quir?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֞ה עֵינֵ֣י׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה בַּמַּמְלָכָה֙ הַֽחַטָּאָ֔ה וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֶ֗פֶס כִּ֠י לֹ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֥יד אַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘ê·nê ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh bam·mam·lā·ḵāh ha·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’āh wə·hiš·maḏ·tî ’ō·ṯāh mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’e·p̄es kî lō haš·mêḏ ’aš·mîḏ ’eṯ- bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Surely the eyes of the Lord GOD are on the sinful kingdom and I will destroy it from the face of the earth Yet I will not utterly destroy . . . the house of Jacob declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Eis que os olhos do Senhor DEUS estão contra este reino pecador, e eu o destruirei de sobre a face da terra; mas não destruirei de todo a casa de Jacó, diz o SENHOR.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וַהֲנִע֥וֹתִי בְכָֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנּ֙וֹעַ֙ בַּכְּבָרָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יִפּ֥וֹל צְר֖וֹר אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh wa·hă·ni·‘ō·w·ṯî ḇə·ḵāl- hag·gō·w·yim ’eṯ- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ka·’ă·šer yin·nō·w·a‘ bak·kə·ḇā·rāh wə·lō- yip·pō·wl ṣə·rō·wr ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For surely I will give the command and I will shake the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve but not a pebble will reach the ground
verses.literalPt: Porque eis que darei ordem, e sacudirei a casa de Israel entre todas as nações, assim como se sacode grão no crivo, sem que caia na terra um só grão.

verses.original: בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּתוּ כֹּ֖ל חַטָּאֵ֣י עַמִּ֑י הָאֹמְרִ֗ים לֹֽא־ תַגִּ֧ישׁ וְתַקְדִּ֛ים בַּעֲדֵ֖ינוּ הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥe·reḇ yā·mū·ṯū kōl ḥaṭ·ṭā·’ê ‘am·mî hā·’ō·mə·rîm lō- ṯag·gîš wə·ṯaq·dîm ba·‘ă·ḏê·nū hā·rā·‘āh
verses.literal: All the sinners among My people will die by the sword all those who say Disaster will never draw near or confront us
verses.literalPt: Todos os pecadores do meu povo morrerão à espada, os que dizem: Não nos alcançará nem nos encontrará o mal.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אָקִ֛ים אֶת־ סֻכַּ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד הַנֹּפֶ֑לֶת וְגָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־ פִּרְצֵיהֶ֗ן וַהֲרִֽסֹתָיו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּבְנִיתִ֖יהָ כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’ā·qîm ’eṯ- suk·kaṯ dā·wîḏ han·nō·p̄e·leṯ wə·ḡā·ḏar·tî ’eṯ- pir·ṣê·hen wa·hă·ri·sō·ṯāw ’ā·qîm ū·ḇə·nî·ṯî·hā kî·mê ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: In that day I will restore the fallen tent of David I will repair its gaps restore its ruins and rebuild it as in the days of old
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia tornarei a levantar o tabernáculo caído de Davi, e repararei as suas brechas, e tornarei a levantar as suas ruínas, e o edificarei como nos dias da antiguidade;

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִֽירְשׁ֜וּ אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֤ית אֱדוֹם֙ וְכָל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה זֹּֽאת׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an yî·rə·šū ’eṯ- šə·’ê·rîṯ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm wə·ḵāl hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- niq·rā šə·mî ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um- Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh zōṯ
verses.literal: that they may possess the remnant of Edom and all the nations that bear My name . . . declares the LORD who will do this
verses.literalPt: Para que possuam o restante de Edom, e todos os gentios que são chamados pelo meu nome, diz o SENHOR, que faz essas coisas.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְנִגַּ֤שׁ חוֹרֵשׁ֙ בַּקֹּצֵ֔ר וְדֹרֵ֥ךְ עֲנָבִ֖ים בְּמֹשֵׁ֣ךְ הַזָּ֑רַע וְהִטִּ֤יפוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ עָסִ֔יס וְכָל־ הַגְּבָע֖וֹת תִּתְמוֹגַֽגְנָה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh yā·mîm bā·’îm nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·nig·gaš ḥō·w·rêš baq·qō·ṣêr wə·ḏō·rêḵ ‘ă·nā·ḇîm bə·mō·šêḵ haz·zā·ra‘ wə·hiṭ·ṭî·p̄ū he·hā·rîm ‘ā·sîs wə·ḵāl hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ tiṯ·mō·w·ḡaḡ·nāh
verses.literal: Behold the days are coming declares the LORD when the plowman will overtake the reaper and the treader of grapes the sower of seed The mountains will drip with sweet wine with which all the hills will flow
verses.literalPt: Eis que vêm dias, diz o SENHOR, em que o que lavra alcançará ao que sega, e o que pisa as uvas ao que lança a semente; e os montes destilarão mosto, e todos os outeiros se derreterão.

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֮ אֶת־ שְׁב֣וּת עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וּבָנ֞וּ עָרִ֤ים נְשַׁמּוֹת֙ וְיָשָׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְשָׁת֖וּ אֶת־ יֵינָ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־ פְּרִיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇā·nū ‘ā·rîm nə·šam·mō·wṯ wə·yā·šā·ḇū wə·nā·ṭə·‘ū ḵə·rā·mîm wə·šā·ṯū ’eṯ- yê·nām wə·‘ā·śū ḡan·nō·wṯ wə·’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- pə·rî·hem
verses.literal: I will restore My people Israel from captivity they will rebuild and inhabit the ruined cities They will plant vineyards and drink their wine they will make gardens and eat their fruit
verses.literalPt: E trarei do cativeiro meu povo Israel, e eles reedificarão as cidades assoladas, e nelas habitarão, e plantarão vinhas, e beberão o seu vinho, e farão pomares, e lhes comerão o fruto.

verses.original: וּנְטַעְתִּ֖ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֨א יִנָּתְשׁ֜וּ ע֗וֹד מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṭa‘·tîm ‘al- ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·lō yin·nā·ṯə·šū ‘ō·wḏ mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯām ’ă·šer nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: I will firmly plant them in their own land never again to be uprooted from the land that I have given them says the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: E plantá-los-ei na sua terra, e não serão mais arrancados da sua terra que lhes dei, diz o SENHOR teu Deus.
